title: Cleveland Central answers Pontotoc’s third-quarter rally to end Warriors’ season
excerpt: A safety and a Kyan Roberson touchdown put Pontotoc ahead in the third quarter. The Warriors finished 8–3 after a 22–16 home playoff loss.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc took the lead twice against Cleveland Central, the second time on a Kyan Roberson touchdown early in the third quarter. The visiting Wolves answered in the fourth to win 22–16 on Friday, Nov. 13, ending the Warriors’ season at 8–3 in the first round of the Class 5A football playoffs.

Nolan Ashley’s 12-yard touchdown pass to Tay Hill gave Pontotoc a chance to take its first lead. The Warriors converted for two points and were up 8–6 with 4:09 left in the first quarter. Cleveland Central scored all eight points of the second quarter to take a 14–8 lead into halftime.

The Warriors erased that deficit with two scoring plays less than two minutes apart. A safety with 10:37 remaining in the third cut the margin to 14–10. Roberson’s touchdown with 8:59 left put Pontotoc ahead 16–14, a lead the Warriors carried into the fourth quarter.
With 9:51 remaining in the game, Cleveland Central had reclaimed the lead at 22–16. Pontotoc held the Wolves to those eight points in the second half, but the Warriors did not score again.
